verdict.rationale: AnyDesk has no native batch or bulk action of its own. The evidence only offers developer building blocks. Its per-device CLI can be pushed to many machines through external software deployment tools, and its REST API plus an open-source Python module expose per-item calls that users could script into loops. Under the partial-credit boundary, building blocks and external tooling earn no credit, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
